test_title: PYST 120: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 23 Jan, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
‘P % Q’ means ‘P is the brother of Q’.

‘P + Q’ means ‘P is the daughter of Q’.

‘P = Q’ means ‘P is the son of Q’.

‘P # Q’ means ‘P is the wife of Q’.

If L = M # N % O + P, how is L related to P?
solution:
Preparing the family tree diagram by using the following symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9df1c8744f9944f577cb026ed057deeca06dd3daa1eb8d361fdaba80fb33e88.png]

of Q

 
 
 

 

 

 

 

 

**Given expression: **'L = M # N % O + P'

L is the son of M, M is the wife of N, N is the brother of O and O is the daughter of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/228667a9de7b480d6a50242805507556e08e84fcf7dde8eba45eb761df20984f.png] 

Here, L is the grandson or **son's son** of P.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Son’s son**".
